insights.one_liner: Xebia Group's 13-month data and cloud training programme in Amsterdam for engineers with 3-5 years' experience; English-friendly, but not a visa sponsor.

culture.text: Runs 13-month programmes where data and cloud engineers work four days a week inside client teams while training.
Part of the Xebia Group; staff often studied at University of Amsterdam and TU Eindhoven, in data science and computer science.
Describes an international environment of people who like learning, sharing knowledge and having fun.

open.text: All 3 open jobs in Amsterdam don't ask for Dutch.
Not listed as an IND recognised visa sponsor under this name.
Expects 3-5 years of hands-on experience, so it is not aimed at fresh graduates.

worth_knowing.text: At the end of the programme participants can join the client company directly as medior or senior.
